Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class XpressBeesReturnCarrierStatus

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.XpressBeesReturnCarrierStatus
public final class XpressBeesReturnCarrierStatus extends Object
Reverse-pickup milestones. Replacement shipments use XpressBeesShipmentStatus. Reverse journey: Data Received, Out for Pickup, PickDone, InTransit, warehouse delivery. A generated AWB is only a booking. Physical pickup is a later scan.

    • preferReverse

      public static String preferReverse(String current, String incoming)
      Keep the further milestone. A pickup failure can replace a booking or an out-for-pickup scan, and a later out-for-pickup scan can replace that failure on reattempt. Scans after physical pickup are not rolled back by an earlier booking or a failed attempt.
